review_evidence: SampCert/Util/Gaussian/DiscreteGaussian.lean defines discrete Gaussian functions and PMFs and proves summability, normalization, positivity, Fourier/Poisson, and asymptotic results.
SampCert/Samplers/* contains Basic, Code, and Properties developments for Bernoulli, geometric, Gaussian, Laplace, uniform, and related generators.
SampCert/DifferentialPrivacy/* formalizes pure, approximate, Renyi/zero-concentrated privacy, mechanisms, sensitivity, composition, and concrete private queries with correctness/privacy properties.
summary: Retain SampCert as a substantial formalization of certified random samplers and differential privacy, with mathematical analysis and privacy proofs.
